scientific_integrity: Exact combinatorial certificates and standalone elementary-collapse verifier; all results concern the explicitly defined eleven-vertex graph. The ambient sphere homotopy type is credited to earlier general results, rather than newly claimed.
scientific_limitations: The dichotomy classifies inclusion maps into the ambient complex, not the intrinsic homotopy type of every null-carrier restriction. Priority against every possible unpublished or unindexed computation is not established; no independent audit has been performed.
title: The induced-homotopy dichotomy of the Grötzsch graph
